about: Known answers for the park page reader (hand-off 05). level 'must' = the reader must give exactly this from its fixture and never the opposite; level 'report' = the club has no checked answer: give what the page says with its quote, the club compares later. basis says how the club knows. You make the fixtures (small, trimmed, from pages you open by hand); the Red Cliffs page text is supplied. If a page no longer says what a 'must' row says, do NOT bend the reader: write it in your notes with the sentence you saw.
